name: marketing-images
description: Campaign images for ads, social posts and carousels: brief-led concept contact sheets cropped into stable-ID previews, then selected finals with Nano Banana individually or through Gemini's discounted Batch API.

interface.shortDescription: Explore and produce campaign images with Gemini
interface.longDescription: Turn a campaign brief and optional product, brand or character references into one low-cost contact sheet of distinct image concepts, crop it into previews with stable concept IDs, then regenerate only the selected concepts as full-resolution Nano Banana images, individually or through Gemini's discounted Batch API, ready to file as the campaign's approved ad and post assets.
defaultPrompt: Use marketing-image-board to explore image concepts for this campaign brief in one contact sheet.
Use marketing-image-producer to generate my selected board tiles as final 4K campaign images.
Use marketing-image-producer to batch the approved carousel slides for this Instagram post.
